proof_body:
by
  intro 𝕜 E _ _ _ _ T h x
  have hc : T (LinearMap.adjoint T x) = LinearMap.adjoint T (T x) := LinearMap.congr_fun h x
  have h1 : inner 𝕜 (T x) (T x) = inner 𝕜 (LinearMap.adjoint T x) (LinearMap.adjoint T x) := by
    rw [← LinearMap.adjoint_inner_right T x (T x), LinearMap.adjoint_inner_left T (LinearMap.adjoint T x) x, hc]
  rw [norm_eq_sqrt_re_inner (𝕜 := 𝕜) (T x), norm_eq_sqrt_re_inner (𝕜 := 𝕜) (LinearMap.adjoint T x), h1]
target_source: ∀ (𝕜 E : Type*) [RCLike 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E] [FiniteDimensional 𝕜 E] (T : E →ₗ[𝕜] E), T ∘ₗ LinearMap.adjoint T = LinearMap.adjoint T ∘ₗ T → ∀ x, ‖T x‖ = ‖LinearMap.adjoint T x‖
